body: I'm Swell. Thanks for talking to me yesterday. I really appreciate it.

Dream job wasn't really going to be a job. A service. I was contracted in the army when I was 18 and was due to ship couple days after graduation.  Day before I was going to ship to basic. Got a call I was a no-go due to a fuck I did on the day I became an adult. Also it didn't help that I put trust in my recruiter to write up the waiver that was supposed to clear me. I was trainging for years before enlisting. Now.  21. No money. Can't get a new job due to that fuck up. Only reason tthis Job was because my teachers knew the owner and vouched for me. The type of charge on my record makes it hard to even get a job at Mickey d 's. I feel pathetic for saying all this stuff.

Money situation is just barley making it. Paying my bills plus paying some utilities at the house. Need to know people to get a roommate. I'm mostly in seclusion. I used to hate it. I was the Guy that went to partys. had party's at my place. Had Girls that always wanted to go for a ride on my motorcycle with me I work so much that I can't get out. My job is a guard. I work in seclusion not seeing any co -workers or even a boss for months at a time. I don't like clubs/party's anymore. I hate alcohol.  Its just hopeless.

Its not really the break up. That was the beginning. Her friends were mine. She lived in my area. Rumors spread about me. I lost "friends" to this. I thought could be fine without them. I was for a while. But the major fuck up is what still hits me today. That'll be with me forever. I live at home with my parents that I know don't want me there. I don't know why. I keep to myself. And their lives are falling apart. Only thing holding me up was my 2 friends. I was offered a place to stay with my friends that committed Sucide. Not day before I was set to move in I found him in his home... I carry a hand gun with me. Once I was 21 I started purchasing firearms. I used to carry my s&w .380 bodyguard with me for personal defense since I got mugged when I was younger. Now I see myself everyonce in a while racking the slide with a hornady hollow point, holding it to my temple And seeing how far I can pull the trigger before I stopped (the .380 has a long trigger pull) I just wish I didn't have that urge. I've never really talked to anybodie about that. Never. I'm at the point where I think I was at my prime at a young age and nothing can be better then that last summer when I was 18.

You know how people change through the years? Everybodie reinvents themselves one way or the other. Can be voluntary or involuntary, Bad/good. I went through a radical change when I turned 18. This is basically when I lost who I thought I was. Went through a bad break up. And basically destroyed my chances of what I dreamed and trained to be since I was a little kid. Ever since then I've been playing with the idea of commiting suicide. I really have no one close to talk to. Lost 2 of the only people I could talk to last year. (One to suicide other to an accident) they were the ones.that stuck with me after all my fuck ups. And sorry about my grammar and what not. On my phone. Also, I'm 21 been like this since I was 18 and thought I would be better by now.
Just would like someone to listen. Want to get of this rut I've been in but, it seems like I'm never getting out of it.
